# Shoplix

> Shoplix is a free shared shopping list app for families, roommates, couples, and events. Several people share one live list: everyone adds items, claims them ("I'll buy this"), and checks them off in real time, so nothing is forgotten and nothing gets bought twice. Available on iOS, Android, and the web (no account required). Interface in 14 languages (19 regional locales), including English, Ukrainian, Czech, Slovak, Finnish, and Croatian.

Key facts (verified against the app, November 2026):

- Free core with no ads and no sign-up: shared real-time lists, item claiming with avatars, unseen-changes highlights, offline mode, voice input, barcode scanning, receipt scanning, statistics, recipe and template tools.
- Item claiming: tap an item and your avatar appears on it, so other shoppers see who is buying what. The most reliable way to prevent duplicate purchases.
- Two list modes: Household (bought items leave the active list) and Event (bought items stay visible to everyone, duplicate additions trigger a warning, spending is tallied per participant — useful for parties, BBQs, and trips).
- Spending statistics in the free tier: by member, by category, and by product, for week/month/year or a custom range, with per-product price history normalized per kg/L/piece.
- Receipt scanning & reconciliation: add 1–5 photos of a paper receipt (long receipts photographed in overlapping parts are stitched automatically without duplicates) or screenshots of a digital receipt. Shoplix extracts items, weights, quantities, and the total, then reconciles them into three sections: Update prices in History, Mark as bought from list, and Add to History (unplanned), matching lines to clean catalog product names.
- Voice input works in every language the app supports: one spoken phrase ("milk, bread, two kilos of apples") is split into separate items with quantities and units.
- Barcode scanner with automatic product recognition; recipe import from a URL or pasted text with a review step; reusable templates for recurring shops.
- Works offline; changes sync when the connection returns. Real-time sync across all participants' devices.
- Sharing is a link: it opens the app directly on the join screen, or routes through the store install first. No registration is required to join.
- Optional Shoplix Premium removes the free tier's caps (20 templates, 20 recipes, and starter free quotas of 5 AI recipe imports, 20 barcode scans, and 10 receipt scans total; Premium unlocks up to 100 recipe imports/month, 1000 barcode scans/month, and 150 receipt scans/month) and adds animated themes. Claiming, sync, statistics, voice, and offline mode are never paywalled.
